start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya interesting lagta hai?

turns.line: rectangle ke chaaron sides jodenge, 50 plus 30 plus 50 plus 30, 160 metre
turns.reply: Aapka addition poora kijiye, phir unit boliye.
Kabir, aapne chaaron sides jodkar 160 metre nikala—yeh perimeter hai. Ab Bittu ko batane ke liye, rectangle ka rule bataiye.
